league.name: Northwest 2B/1B League
league.summary: League champions! 5 points ahead of Mount Vernon Christian, with a perfect record.

insights.title: State spot locked in
insights.text: Even if they lose every remaining district game, they finish no worse than 3rd place — good enough for State.

insights.title: Perfect league season (9-0)
insights.text: That earned them the #1 ranking in districts, which means a home game and the lowest-ranked opponent first.

insights.title: Providence Classical Christian plays them close
insights.text: Orcas won both meetings, but only by one goal each time (3-2 and 4-3). They could be the next opponent.

insights.title: Unbeaten all season
insights.text: 16 wins and 1 draw. They’ve scored 94 goals and allowed just 13.

insights.title: Defending State champions
insights.text: Fun fact: last year they lost a district game to Mount Vernon Christian and still won State. Once you’re in, districts only decide your ranking.

funnel.text: 10 local schools play each other once. Win = 3 pts, draw = 1.
